_comment: Maps every image slot in ASSETS.md to its Higgsfield source. 'generation' is an image that already exists in the Higgsfield account; 'prompt' is the brief to (re)generate it. tools/fetch-photos.mjs reads this file, downloads each url, crops to ratio, resizes to longEdge and writes theme/assets/<asset>.

slots.prompt: Fine jewellery editorial photograph, vertical. A woman's hand at rest on folded ivory linen, anatomically correct five slender fingers, short bare natural nails, wearing a single slender 18k yellow gold solitaire ring with a round brilliant diamond. Hand low in the frame, generous empty warm bone-coloured space above. Medium format digital, 100mm macro, f/5.6. Soft diffused north-window light through a scrim, delicate soft-edged shadow. Muted warm-neutral colour grade, low saturation, film-like, no orange cast. Natural unretouched skin texture. Photoreal gold and crisp diamond facets. No text, no logos, no watermark.

Extreme macro fine jewellery photograph, vertical. A tight detail of the four-claw setting and cut-down gallery of an 18k yellow gold solitaire engagement ring, the round brilliant diamond filling the upper frame, the openwork gallery and claw tips crisply resolved, on warm bone paper. Medium format digital, 100mm macro, f/11, focus stacked. Soft diffused north light, delicate shadow. Muted warm-neutral colour grade, low saturation, film-like. Photoreal polished gold and realistic diamond fire, no rainbow overload. Minimal, gallery-like. No text, no logos, no watermark.

Fine jewellery product photograph, vertical. A single platinum engagement ring with a large emerald-cut diamond and two tapered baguette side stones, standing upright and very slightly angled, centred low in the frame on warm bone paper, generous empty space above. Medium format digital, 100mm macro, f/8, focus stacked. One soft diffused north-window light, one delicate soft-edged shadow. Muted warm-neutral colour grade, low saturation, film-like, no HDR. Photoreal platinum and clean step-cut facets, no rainbow flare. Impeccably clean, minimal, gallery-like. No text, no logos, no watermark, no props.
